$comment: Findings of the iPhone checks (qa/checks/iphone.mjs) that were looked at and decided,
not ignored. A finding that matches an entry here reports as `info` with the reason;
anything not listed reports at its own severity. An entry that stops matching in a full
weekly run is reported as stale: remove it, the thing it excused is gone.
Match fields (all given ones must match): check, route (exact), modal (substring of the
button that opened the dialog), text (substring of the element's text), severity.

accepted.reason: The bottom bar's "more" sheet is taller than the screen for roles with many links (44px rows since #557). It is capped at the screen and scrolls; a two-column layout was offered and declined.
The "when does the process run" dialog is taller than the smaller iPhones and scrolls; its save and cancel buttons are pinned to the bottom (#560).
dir="auto" turns left to right because the seeded rows start with the Latin "[DEMO]" prefix. Real data that starts in Hebrew does not.
